section_1_result.basis: The authorized local Main-side credential-reference composition boundary is implemented and the required scoped validation is passing.

details: Added the Main-side PddSecretReferenceService composition boundary.
Added focused synthetic-value tests for lifecycle, rediscovery, scope isolation, and fail-closed behavior.
Added the existing SecretStore workspace dependency to the desktop package and lockfile.
No PDD credential acquisition, login, session validation, receive/send runtime, or network behavior was added.

basis: The existing PlatformAccount persistence contract uses id as the local entity primary key.
PlatformAccount.id is distinct from merchant scope and optional externalRef.
The approved SHEEP-084 contract permits derivation from PlatformAccount.id after trusted merchant and platform validation.

section_4_selected_rediscovery_model.details: The reference is deterministically derived from the validated PlatformAccount.id and is not separately persisted.

section_5_reference_key_contract.format: A Main-private approved namespace followed by a SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the validated PlatformAccount.id.
properties: Does not use PlatformAccount.externalRef, customerUid, mall_cs-side UID, session state, or ambient UI selection.
Is stable across service reconstruction for the same PlatformAccount.id.
Satisfies the existing SecretStore key format without exposing the key through the public service surface.

operations: replace/re-register at the same derived account key
resolve inside the Main-side service boundary
constraints: Resolves the existing PlatformAccount before SecretStore access.
Requires trusted merchant containment and platform=pdd.
Does not expose arbitrary SecretStore keys or a public reference parser.
Uses only synthetic non-secret values in tests.

section_7_restart_rediscovery.behavior: A newly constructed service with the same authoritative PlatformAccount repository, trusted merchant scope, and SecretStore state resolves the existing entry without a mapping row.
non_implications: Secret presence does not imply authenticated.
Secret presence does not imply session_valid.
Secret presence does not imply seller_verified, authorized, entitled, or send_ready.

checks: Different valid PlatformAccount.id values use distinct effective derived keys.
An entry registered for Account A is not resolved for Account B.
A merchant-scope mismatch fails before SecretStore access.
A non-PDD account fails before SecretStore access.
No ambient shop, session, UI selection, or caller-supplied reference can redirect lookup.

section_9_failure_fail_closed_behavior.fallbacks: No plaintext, Renderer input, DOM, SQLite, environment variable, legacy-import in-memory adapter, or test-store fallback is introduced.

section_12_files_modified.note: Only the desktop workspace dependency declaration and its lockfile importer entry were changed.

focused_coverage: replace uses the same account-derived reference

details: No credential_ref column or mapping table was added.
PlatformAccount.externalRef remains nullable and unbound for this contract.
Secret material remains owned by SecretStore rather than ordinary SQLite persistence.
